name: Sword Factory [BETA]
desc:
⚔️ Welcome to Sword Factory! ⚔️

👍 Like the game and join the group for +25% Cash!

How to Play:
⚔️ Spawn a Sword
💸 Sell and generate money
🤺 Fight mobs for money and swords
🏭 Upgrade your factory
🐦‍🔥 Unlock new machines and sword traits!

🍀 There are over 300M+ different Sword variants!
⭐ Remember, your factory runs while you are offline!

💻 Supports PC, Console, Mobile & Tablet players
